schema.content:
Table "Accounts" {
  "account_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "date_account_opened" TIMESTAMP
  "account_name" TEXT
  "other_account_details" TEXT
}

Table "Customers" {
  "customer_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_first_name" TEXT
  "customer_middle_initial" TEXT
  "customer_last_name" TEXT
  "gender" TEXT
  "email_address" TEXT
  "login_name" TEXT
  "login_password" TEXT
  "phone_number" TEXT
  "town_city" TEXT
  "state_county_province" TEXT
  "country" TEXT
}

Table "Financial_Transactions" {
  "transaction_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "account_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "invoice_number" INTEGER
  "transaction_type" TEXT [not null]
  "transaction_date" TIMESTAMP
  "transaction_amount" TEXT
  "transaction_comment" TEXT
  "other_transaction_details" TEXT
}

Table "Invoice_Line_Items" {
  "order_item_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "invoice_number" INTEGER [not null]
  "product_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "product_title" TEXT
  "product_quantity" TEXT
  "product_price" TEXT
  "derived_product_cost" TEXT
  "derived_vat_payable" TEXT
  "derived_total_cost" TEXT
}

Table "Invoices" {
  "invoice_number" INTEGER [pk]
  "order_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "invoice_date" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Order_Items" {
  "order_item_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "order_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "product_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "product_quantity" TEXT
  "other_order_item_details" TEXT
}

Table "Orders" {
  "order_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "date_order_placed" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "order_details" TEXT
}

Table "Product_Categories" {
  "production_type_code" TEXT [pk]
  "product_type_description" TEXT
  "vat_rating" TEXT
}

Table "Products" {
  "product_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "parent_product_id" INTEGER
  "production_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "unit_price" TEXT
  "product_name" TEXT
  "product_color" TEXT
  "product_size" TEXT
}

Ref: "Financial_Transactions"."invoice_number" > "Invoices"."invoice_number"

Ref: "Order_Items"."order_id" > "Orders"."order_id"

Ref: "Order_Items"."product_id" > "Products"."product_id"

Ref: "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id" > "Products"."product_id"

Ref: "Invoice_Line_Items"."invoice_number" > "Invoices"."invoice_number"

Ref: "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" > "Order_Items"."order_item_id"
